verdict.rationale: Maritime has one documented natural-language control path of its own: you tell an OpenClaw-family or Hermes agent something like "send me a digest every weekday at 9", and the platform syncs that into real wake triggers. Broader natural-language operation (install, authenticate, deploy) relies on an external assistant such as Claude or Cursor driving the agent-operable CLI from a pasted prompt, which is a building block rather than built-in natural-language control. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface covering general platform operations (deploy, configure, manage), natural-language trigger setting beyond specific templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask the agent (OpenClaw-family and Hermes templates): tell it "send me a digest every weekday at 9" and the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers.
Paste one prompt into Claude, Cursor, or any assistant and it can install the CLI, authenticate, and deploy agents for you.
